title: ACE-Step 1.5 C++ Port (acestep.cpp)
summary: A lightweight, portable C++ implementation of the ACE-Step 1.5 music foundation model built on the GGML backend. It enables high-fidelity 48kHz stereo music generation with zero Python dependencies on consumer CPUs and GPUs.
research_notes: Utilizes a two-stage pipeline consisting of ace-lm for composition and ace-synth for diffusion-based rendering.

evolution.summary: The project evolved from a CPU-only port to a mature ecosystem with CUDA, Metal, and Vulkan support. Recent updates added GGUF quantization, VST3 integration for DAWs, and an 'Understand Mode' for audio-to-metadata analysis.
